narrative: The grey cloak still on him. The pocket tables lie shut on the bed. Yesterday's smear is hidden by the cover. The cat is not on this tread. No face. A hand on the cover, not lifting it. Grey light from the west window. The apples are a floor below, out of sight. No face. The tables where they were. The stylus is in the gutter of the shut book. He has sat down. No face.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Waited with the cover down, then wrote the three words and stopped.

entities.name: the writing-tables
entities.context: Shown on tables in Went up and sat with the tables shut
